answer: Not every flood can be dammed, but every flood can be metered. Make the ledge the protocol's birth channel: a brand-new account may only enter the river of attestation trade through a rate-limited bridge, minted slots per epoch capped and queued months deep. Sybils rise overnight; farms cannot wait in queue. Abuse the gate and you forfeit the ledge - any aged account sponsoring a rush of clones loses its own standing at once. Farming stops being cheap and becomes slow, and slow is the one cost a bot cannot pay.
